newsitem.title: USA: Ultralife Batteries says gets contract.
newsitem.headline: Ultralife Batteries says gets contract.

text.p: Ultralife Batteries Inc said Tuesday it has received a contract from a computer manufacturer to develop batteries for a new line of portable computers.
Ultralife said it will receive about $800,000 for the initial phase of the program.
Ultralife said it is withholding the name of the computer manufacturer for competitive reasons.
Ultralife said the batteries will be used in a new line of notebook computers.
Ultralife said it estimates there could be initial annual sales of the batteries in excess of $10 million.
